title: Affine form under sign negation
statement: Let $a_0\in\mathbb{R}$, let $a\in\mathbb{R}^n$, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The affine linear form with coefficients $(a_0,a)$ evaluated at the coordinatewise negation of $x$ equals $a_0$ minus the linear form with coefficients $a$ evaluated at $x$.
